Frequently Asked Questions

Is there a free trial?

Yes — every plan includes a 7-day free trial. No credit card required to start.

Can I change plans later?

Absolutely. You can upgrade or downgrade at any time. Changes take effect immediately.

What payment methods do you accept?

We accept all major credit cards and bank transfers for annual plans.

Is my data safe?

Your data is fully isolated per farm (multi-tenant architecture) and encrypted at rest and in transit.

Do you offer a discount for annual billing?

Yes — annual plans save 20% compared to monthly billing.

What happens after my trial?

You'll be prompted to choose a plan. If you don't, your account enters read-only mode — no data is deleted.
